issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the new actions, policy, factory, migration, or call-path enforcement despite conventions requiring tests for every feature including authorization paths.
Identical isUniqueViolation helper is copy-pasted in CreateQueue and UpdateQueue instead of a shared helper.
isUniqueViolation maps any SQLSTATE 23000 to a slug ValidationException, which could mask a non-slug integrity violation.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:54, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:208, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:132 use app/Actions with Gate policies; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:432; database/migrations/2026_09_07_000000_create_queue_access_table.php:610 down() reversible; app/Models/QueueAccess.php:321 $fillable deliberate; docs/business-rules.md:626, docs/database-schema.md:649, CHANGELOG.md:9 kept in sync; but TDD no-production-code-without-test violated with zero tests

readability.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:54, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:208, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:132 clear names and small focused methods; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:464 documented call rule; consistent with sibling style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:54-86 trimmed name, Str::slug default, per-entity unique plus QueryException->ValidationException; app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:208-270 nullable name/slug/isActive with own-slug allowed; app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:132-187 upsert/revoke, cross-entity and unknown-permission ValidationException, audit queue.access.granted/revoked with actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id and no log on no-op revoke; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:436-488 create/update/manageAccess/call with corrupted non-array deny; app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:29 and app/Models/Ticket.php:391-411 inactive-then-authorize-then-waiting order; migration unique pair with cascade FKs; enum/model/factory/policy contracts match

scope.evidence: change.diff: every hunk serves queue lifecycle, queue_access grants, QueuePolicy enforcement, or required docs/CHANGELOG; no delete action added; no unrelated refactors or UI

security.evidence: Gate::forUser authorize in app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:56, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:210, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:133, app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:29, app/Models/Ticket.php:405; input validation with ValidationException before writes; app/Models/QueueAccess.php:321 $fillable; no unescaped output or secrets

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct reuse of Gate, Str::slug, updateOrCreate, QueueAccess lookup; app/Enums/QueuePermission.php:5 single case; but isUniqueViolation duplicated verbatim in app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:98 and app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:273

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ or Pest files; no happy-path, ValidationException, AuthorizationException, inactive-queue, race, or audit-logging coverage for new behavior

review.summary: Implements the queue lifecycle, queue_access grants with audit logging, QueuePolicy, and both call-path enforcements with correct contracts and ordering. Blocked by zero shipped tests despite the TDD requirement, with only minor duplication and an over-broad unique-violation mapping otherwise.
